journey.name: spark emergency exit
journey.description:
Verifies the Spark emergency exit up to the swipe. With a Spark balance, the Spark connection screen shows "Emergency exit" (testTag "SparkEmergencyExit") under "Transfer to Savings". It opens the explainer, then the quote, which asks the SDK's prepareRecoverFunds for every leaf and lists "Amount to exit", "Network fees", "You receive about" and, when the exit needs CPFP fee funding, "Fee funding needed". Continue leads to the funding screen, whose "Fund from another wallet" shows the funding address as a QR code. The journey stops before the swipe: starting an exit takes the Spark balance out of Spending for days. The states after the swipe are covered by SparkExitDriverTest and the SparkExitProgressScreen previews.
Precondition: dev build with Spark connected on its regtest (no key needed) and a Spark balance, funded at the deposit address the Spark connection screen shows (testTag "SparkDepositAddress") from Lightspark's regtest faucet. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Scroll down and verify "Transfer to Savings" (testTag "SparkTransferToSavings") is enabled and "Emergency exit" (testTag "SparkEmergencyExit") shows under it
Tap "Emergency exit" and verify the "Leave Spark on-chain" explainer says the exit takes up to 4 weeks
Tap "Continue" (testTag "SparkExitIntroContinue") and verify the "Exit quote" screen shows "Getting a quote…" and then "Amount to exit", "Network fees" and "You receive about"
Verify no reason shows in red (testTag "SparkExitQuoteBlocked") and "Continue" (testTag "SparkExitQuoteContinue") is enabled

Tap "Continue" and verify the "Fund the fees" screen names the fee funding amount, with "Pay from savings" (testTag "SparkExitFundSavings") and "Fund from another wallet" (testTag "SparkExitFundExternal")
Tap "Fund from another wallet" and verify a QR code and a bcrt1 address (testTag "SparkExitFundingAddress") show, and "Continue" (testTag "SparkExitFundingContinue") is disabled
Go back to the Spark connection screen and verify "Transfer to Savings" is still enabled: nothing started
